column1: # pass 275 — 2026-10-17 — TREE ENUMERATION applied to LICENCE paths for the first time.
# 🔴 NOT a new method on this base: compose/code/p275-tree-enumeration/ (pase 93, 2026-10-04)
# already states P275 ("para sostener una ausencia en un arbol hay que ENUMERARLO") and P278
# ("un conteo de CERO sobre una ruta que no existe en esa ref mide la RUTA, no el contenido")
# and already ships a blobless-clone enumerator.  It was applied to DIRECTORY trees and never
# to licence paths.  P278 describes both false negatives below exactly.
# WHY: p274 found gegok12 refuted twice by probing a slug that does not exist, and ranked
# "re-probe every negative licence verdict with ls-remote as a positive control" as p275's
# highest-value item. That control passed (see verdict_on_slug below) — but running it
# exposed that the LADDER ITSELF is the defect, not the slug.
# method, in two stages, no searches:
#   1. git ls-remote https://github.com/<slug> HEAD    -> does the slug resolve AT ALL?
#   2. git clone --depth 1 --filter=blob:none --no-checkout, then git ls-tree -r --name-only HEAD
#      -> ENUMERATE every path in the tree, then grep the enumeration for licence-like names.
# A 19-path probe can only refute the 19 paths it tried.  An enumeration cannot miss a path
# that exists, because it never guesses one.
# channel re-tested this pass, NOT inherited: raw.githubusercontent.com 200 · git smart-HTTP (ls-remote
# + blobless clone) OK · api.github.com/rate_limit 200 BUT api.github.com/repos/<slug> 403 and
# api.github.com/search 403 (session-scope message, NOT a rate limit) · github.com HTML 403.
# => api.github.com is NOT open.  p274's "403" was correct; a 200 on /rate_limit is a proxy-level
#    reply and must not be read as repo access.  NO star count was read from GitHub this pass either.
